description:
The Sanitas Style All-Road is engineered for riders who demand uncompromising performance across every surface. The Style All-Road represents the pinnacle of modern design. Experience the perfect fusion of timeless craftsmanship and cutting-edge performance. Precision-built from aerospace-grade titanium, the frame offers an unmatched combination of lightweight strength and exceptional ride quality—engineered to perform flawlessly for a lifetime of riding.

Titanium’s natural damping properties deliver a smooth, composed ride over long distances, reducing fatigue while maintaining razor-sharp responsiveness. Whether climbing steep gradients or accelerating on open roads, the frame transfers power efficiently, ensuring every pedal stroke feels purposeful and controlled.

Designed with modern geometry, ideal balance between comfort and speed. Its refined frame design supports all-day riding positions without sacrificing agility, making it equally suited for high-performance training, gran fondos, and competitive racing.

Built for riders who value precision, durability, and understated luxury, our Style All-Road is more than a machine—it’s a lifelong companion for the pursuit of speed, distance, and excellence on every ride.

Each frame is designed and built one by one in our Durango, Colorado, facility to provide a ride that’s specifically tailored to the customer’s riding style and needs.

The customization does not stop with your frame geometry or finish! Drivetrain and components are just as personal as your riding style! With the ability to hand-select the components of your choice, you have 100% say in building out the bike of your dreams. Complete bike builds are quoted upon request and individualized for each rider.
